title: Measuring and Reducing Gendered Correlations in Pre-trained Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using four metrics: Coreference Resolution (WinoGender dataset testing pronoun resolution across professions), adapted Semantic Textual Similarity (STS-B) comparing similarity scores for gendered terms and professions, Bias-in-Bios (measuring the True Positive Rate gap between binary genders in biography profession classification), and a novel metric called DisCo (Discovery of Correlations) which uses template-based masked language modeling to discover intrinsic correlations with gendered names and terms.
